title: soothfast.lock
description: Committed fingerprints of every bound item, at the workspace root. `docs check` reports a bind stale when its current fingerprint differs from the locked one; `docs accept` re-locks. Readers ignore unknown keys and default every missing key, so no key is required; a missing file reads as an empty map.

version.description: Lockfile format. Currently 2, bumped whenever the fingerprint input changes. A file without it reads as 1; a lower version than the build's reads as needing one re-accept, and a higher one is refused by `docs accept`.

binds.description: Bound item path to hex fingerprint. Entries whose value is not a string are ignored.
